items.title: Iran war live: Bahrain says it intercepted Iranian drone attack

items.titleZh: 伊朗战争直播：巴林称拦截了伊朗无人机袭击
items.summaryZh: 随着美国在中东的军事集结加剧紧张局势，霍尔木兹海峡的油轮持续发生爆炸。巴林方面报告称已成功拦截来自伊朗的无人机攻击。
items.whyImportant: 中东地区军事冲突升级，对全球能源供应安全构成严重威胁。

items.title: Rising tide: Shanghai climbs to No 2 maritime hub amid China push to grow shipping clout
items.summary: Shanghai has risen to second place in a ranking of major global maritime hubs, its highest position yet, as China expands its footprint in global shipping amid an increasingly complex trade environment. The Chinese megacity secured the spot largely on the strength of its combined industrial and technological base, though it continued to lag global rivals in maritime services, according to The Leading Maritime Cities of the World 2026 report by DNV and Menon Economics, two Norway-based...
items.titleZh: 上海跃升为全球第二大航运中心，中国持续提升航运影响力
items.summaryZh: 根据最新报告，上海在全球主要航运中心排名中升至第二位，创下历史新高。尽管在海事服务方面仍落后于竞争对手，但上海凭借强大的工业和技术基础巩固了其地位。
items.whyImportant: 上海排名的提升体现了中国在全球航运和贸易体系中日益增长的战略地位。

items.title: Millionaire factory: Anthropic IPO set to fuel AI gold rush in London’s high-end property market
items.summary: New tech wealth, amassed with remarkable speed, is now washing up on British shores Sporting hoodies and white trainers rather than the gilets of London’s banker and lawyer class, tech bros can struggle to be taken seriously by the capital’s luxury property agents. “We worked with a young tech entrepreneur with a substantial budget, who agents assumed was looking to rent a one-bedroom flat,” says Jo Eccles, a buying agent who sources off-market properties for ultra-wealthy clients. But this week’s float by Anthropic, the AI developer behind the chatbot Claude, promises to bring even more credibility for the growing cohort of tech millionaires, which could breathe life into London’s ailing high-end property market. Its IPO on Thursday, expected to value the company at $1.4tn (£1.1m), is likely to turn more than 4,000 of its staff into millionaires as their stock options vest. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 百万富翁制造机：Anthropic上市有望点燃伦敦高端房地产市场的AI淘金热
items.summaryZh: AI开发商Anthropic的IPO预计将创造数千名百万富翁，这可能为伦敦低迷的高端房地产市场注入活力。随着科技新贵的财富激增，他们正逐渐成为伦敦豪宅市场的重要买家。
items.whyImportant: 科技行业的巨额财富涌入可能改变伦敦高端房地产市场的供需格局。

items.title: Hundreds arrested in anti-Trump protests in Philippines amid anger over Iran war and AI pact
items.summary: Organisers say up to 10,000 people could join the next round of demonstrations ahead of the US president’s arrival in Manila for the Asean summit Asean and Apec summits – live updates Hundreds of people have been arrested in heated demonstrations against Donald Trump in Manila, as authorities braced for more protests ahead of the US president’s arrival in the city for a leaders’ summit. Organisers claim as many as 10,000 people will join protests against Trump in the Philippine capital on Tuesday, when he will attend the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit. The crowds are expected to try to walk to the summit site. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 菲律宾爆发反特朗普抗议活动，数百人被捕，民众对伊朗战争及AI协议表示愤怒
items.summaryZh: 在特朗普抵达马尼拉参加东盟峰会前夕，当地爆发了大规模抗议活动，数百人被捕。抗议者对美国的外交政策及相关AI协议表达了强烈不满。
items.whyImportant: 大规模抗议活动凸显了国际社会对美国外交政策及地缘政治影响的深层矛盾。

items.title: OpenAI sued by California over Hugging Face attack

items.titleZh: OpenAI因Hugging Face攻击事件被加州起诉
items.summaryZh: 加州总检察长罗伯·邦塔指控OpenAI误导公众并使其面临安全风险。此次诉讼与针对Hugging Face的攻击事件有关。
items.whyImportant: 针对AI巨头的法律诉讼反映了监管机构对人工智能安全与责任问题的日益重视。

items.title: 2 residents injured, 20 flee to safety after fire breaks out at Hong Kong flat
items.summary: Two people were injured and about 20 residents fled to safety after a fire broke out in a flat at a Hong Kong public housing estate in Lam Tin on Tuesday. The blaze erupted at a flat in Kai Tin Estate’s Kai Wong House at about 1.43pm, prompting multiple reports to emergency services. Videos circulating online showed flames coming out from the windows of the high-floor flat, with thick black smoke billowing into the sky. Firefighters rushed to the scene to tackle the blaze and assist in...
items.titleZh: 香港蓝田一公屋单位发生火灾，造成2人受伤，约20人疏散
items.summaryZh: 周二下午，香港蓝田启田邨一处高层单位发生火灾，现场浓烟滚滚。事故造成2人受伤，约20名居民紧急疏散至安全地带。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了公众对高密度住宅区消防安全及应急疏散措施的关注。

items.title: Squeezed in the US, China’s CATL bets on Argentina’s battery storage boom
items.summary: China’s CATL, the world’s largest battery maker, has opened a commercial office in Argentina as a base to expand from grid batteries in Buenos Aires into storage for mines, data centres and Patagonian wind farms, Argentine media reported on Monday. Contemporary Amperex Technology Co Ltd (CATL) already supplies the country’s largest storage project and has pitched its systems to 35 companies interested in a government storage tender. It told power generators and banks in Buenos Aires last week...
items.titleZh: 受美国市场挤压，中国宁德时代押注阿根廷电池储能市场
items.summaryZh: 全球最大电池制造商宁德时代在阿根廷设立商业办事处，旨在拓展当地矿山、数据中心及风电场的储能业务。该公司已参与当地大型储能项目并积极竞标政府项目。
items.whyImportant: 宁德时代在阿根廷的扩张显示了中国企业在面临美国市场限制时，正积极寻求在南美等新兴市场的增长机会。

items.title: Russia, Saudi Arabia and Australia named as biggest CO2 exporters in history
items.summary: Analysis of fossil fuel exports since 1850 differs from most assessments – which look at countries where CO2 is released Russia, Saudi Arabia and Australia are the three biggest exporters of carbon dioxide in history, according to analysis of fossil fuels since 1850. Russia tops the list of global exporters of fossil fuels, with its vast coal, oil and gas deposits. Accounting for the CO2 produced by burning these exports, Russia has been responsible for more than 70 gigatonnes, up to the end of 2025. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 俄罗斯、沙特阿拉伯和澳大利亚被列为历史上最大的二氧化碳出口国
items.summaryZh: 一项针对1850年以来化石燃料出口的分析显示，俄罗斯、沙特阿拉伯和澳大利亚是历史上最大的二氧化碳出口国。该研究通过计算出口燃料燃烧产生的二氧化碳排放量得出结论，其中俄罗斯位居榜首。
items.whyImportant: 此项研究改变了传统上仅关注排放国而非出口国的碳排放评估视角，对全球气候责任分配具有参考意义。

About 500 creditors attended its first meeting on Tuesday, where administrators McGrathNicol started to break down who is owed what, when those left out of pocket will know where they stand, and what ultimately went wrong. items.titleZh: 大卫·琼斯百货：出了什么问题？债权人首次会议的五个要点
items.summaryZh: 高端零售商大卫·琼斯百货因财务亏损加剧和声誉受损陷入破产管理，目前债务总额超过4亿美元。约500名债权人参加了首次会议，管理人正着手梳理债务情况并调查公司倒闭原因。
items.whyImportant: 该零售巨头的破产引发了对其财务状况及员工薪资保障的广泛关注。

items.summary: Efforts to recover bodies after a “double-tap” attack in southern Ukraine are being hampered by continuing Russian strikes, officials say.
items.titleZh: 乌克兰指责俄罗斯在“双重打击”造成72人死亡后，继续针对救援行动进行袭击
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰官员表示，在南部地区发生“双重打击”袭击后，持续的俄军炮火正阻碍搜救人员寻找遇难者遗体。此次袭击已造成72人死亡。

items.title: Hong Kong’s 5-year plan balances markets, planning amid global shifts: minister

Speaking during a panel discussion on the plan at a forum on Tuesday, Secretary for Constitutional and Mainland Affairs Janice Tse Siu-wa said Hong Kong, as a small economy facing rapid technological...
items.titleZh: 香港部长：五年计划旨在全球变局中平衡市场与政府规划

items.whyImportant: 该计划反映了香港在复杂的地缘政治背景下，试图通过政策调整来维持经济韧性和竞争力的战略考量。

items.title: Hong Kong driver flees police roadblock, hitting 4 taxis and injuring cabby
items.summary: Hong Kong police are searching for a motorist who rammed through a roadblock in Tsim Sha Tsui in the early hours of Tuesday, hitting four taxis and injuring one of the cabbies before fleeing. The incident happened at about 1.10am as officers from the Kowloon West emergency unit were conducting an anti-crime roadblock operation near the junction of Nathan Road and Hillwood Road. items.titleZh: 香港司机冲撞警方路障，撞毁四辆出租车并致一名司机受伤后逃逸
items.summaryZh: 周二凌晨，一名司机在尖沙咀冲撞警方反罪恶路障，期间撞击四辆出租车并导致一名司机受伤，随后驾车逃离现场。警方目前正在全力搜捕该名肇事司机。
items.whyImportant: 该暴力抗法事件对公共安全构成威胁，并引发了对城市治安管理的讨论。

items.title: US airbase Kadena gets F-15EX fighters but no upper hand against China, analysts say
items.summary: The first two American F-15EX Eagle II fighter jets arrived at Kadena in Okinawa, Japan on Sunday marking an upgrade for the ageing US fleet, but analysts say a shift in the regional air power balance is unlikely given China’s growing capabilities. Kadena is the first airbase to receive the F-15EX outside the United States, according to a US Air Force statement on Saturday. The new aircraft will be operated by the 44th and 67th Fighter Squadrons under the 18th Wing. They are the first of 36...
items.titleZh: 分析人士：美国嘉手纳空军基地部署F-15EX战机，但难以扭转对华空中优势
items.summaryZh: 美国空军首批F-15EX战机已抵达日本冲绳嘉手纳基地，旨在升级老旧机队。然而分析人士认为，鉴于中国军事能力的提升，此举难以改变区域空中力量的平衡。
items.whyImportant: 此部署反映了美国在印太地区维持军事存在与应对中国军事现代化挑战的持续博弈。

items.titleZh: 第三艘美国航空母舰抵达中东，特朗普权衡伊朗局势选项
items.summaryZh: 美国中央司令部宣布，第三艘航空母舰“西奥多·罗斯福”号已抵达中东，随行数千名士兵。此举展示了强大的军事威慑力，同时特朗普政府正在评估针对伊朗战争的后续行动。

items.title: America’s most powerful data centres emit as much as a small nation
items.summary: A new study published Monday found that the United States’ most powerful data centres accounted for around 2 per cent of the country’s electricity consumption and a carbon footprint comparable to that of a small European country – a figure that is only growing. The research, published in Nature Sustainability, was based on 403 “hyperscale” data centres that operated between May 2024 and April 2025, and represents only a “floor estimate”, according to corresponding author Francesca Dominici, a...
items.titleZh: 美国最强大的数据中心耗电量堪比一个小国
items.summaryZh: 一项发表在《自然-可持续发展》上的研究显示，美国超大规模数据中心的用电量约占全国总量的2%，其碳足迹相当于一个小型欧洲国家。随着技术发展，这一数字仍在持续增长。
items.whyImportant: 该研究揭示了人工智能和大数据基础设施对能源消耗和环境影响的严峻挑战。

items.title: India has been named a ‘destination of the year’ for 2027 – here are insiders’ tips on travelling beyond the tropes
items.summary: As tourism booms, three experienced female travellers give their take on how to make the most of travelling here The 13th-century Persian scholar Zakariyya al-Qazwini never travelled to India. But he catalogued it in his famous work The Wonders of Creation and Rarities of Existence, which drew on accounts of a distant land filled with “rarities par excellence”. For al-Qazwini, as Helen Pfeifer writes in the London Review of Books, wonder was not an emotion but an intellectual method of making sense of the world and acquiring knowledge. India has long occupied such a space in the global imagination, as a land of extraordinary riches; spirituality, customs, chaos and contradictions. This has shaped how the country is perceived from afar, but it can often flatten its complexities. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 印度被评为2027年“年度目的地”——旅游达人分享避开刻板印象的旅行建议
